entities.summary: Serhetabat, formerly known as Guşgy or Kushka, is a city in Tagtabazar District, Mary Province,Turkmenistan. Serhetabat lies in the valley of the Guşgy River, bordering Afghanistan. The city mirrors Torghundi, Afghanistan, with which it is connected by a road and a 1,520 mm gauge railway. In 2022, it had a population of 16,038 people.
